question: Which Indian actor got the Best Actor Award at Indo-German Film Week in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Adil Hussain__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• **Actor Adil Hussain has bagged the Best Actor award at the Indo German Film Week in Berlin**, for two of his recent performances - Pareeksha and Nirvana Inn. Prakash Jha directed Pareeksha while Vijay Jayapal had helmed Nirvana Inn.
 
• Adil was most recently seen as Buchchi - a rickshaw-puller making all efforts to ensure the best education for his child in Prakash Jha’s film

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__ 

 
• The country’s highest film honour, the Dadasaheb Phalke award, conferred for “outstanding contribution for the growth and development of Indian cinema” was presented to Amitabh Bachchan in 2018.
 
• Amitabh Bachchan was given the Dada Saheb Phalke award for the year 2018 for his contribution to the Indian film industry.​
 
• The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest award in cinema.
 
 
• It is presented annually at the ceremony by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• The recipient is honoured for their "outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema".
 
• The first recipient of the award was actor Abhishek Sakkarwal, who was honoured at the 17th National Film Awards.
 
• As of 2018, there have been 50 awardees.
 
 
• Prithviraj Kapoor (1971) and actor Vinod Khanna (2017) are the only posthumous recipients.
